comparisons.peer_summary: The provision for income taxes increased in fiscal years 2024 and 2023, primarily due to a non-recurring intra-group transfer of IP rights to the U.S. in 2024 and higher pre-tax income in 2023.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom disclose the primary drivers behind the changes in their income tax provisions for fiscal year 2024. AMD attributes its increase in tax provision to higher pre-tax income and a specific $373 million tax effect from an intercompany integration transaction. Similarly, Broadcom attributes its increase in tax provision to a non-recurring intra-group transfer of IP rights to the U.S. (an intercompany transaction) and higher pre-tax income. Both companies cite structural intercompany transactions and profitability levels as key factors driving their respective tax provision fluctuations.

sentences.text: The Company recorded an income tax provision of $381 million and an income tax benefit of $346 million in 2024 and 2023, respectively, representing effective tax rates of 19% and (68)%, respectively.
The increase in income tax provision in 2024 was primarily due to higher pre-tax income and a $373 million tax effect from an intercompany integration transaction.

The increase in provision for income taxes in fiscal year 2024 compared to fiscal year 2023 was primarily due to the impact of a non-recurring intra-group transfer of certain IP rights to the United States as a result of supply chain realignment and the resulting shift in jurisdictional mix of income, partially offset by an increase in excess tax benefits from stock-based awards.

The increase in provision for income taxes in fiscal year 2023 compared to fiscal year 2022 was primarily due to higher income before income taxes, partially offset by an increase in the recognition of uncertain tax benefits as a result of lapses of statutes of limitations.
